_meta.note: All claims verified against source. This brief is the shared input for every downstream audit lane.

stack.ui_runtime: React 19 (@astrojs/react ^4.2.1) — used only for interactive islands (TownSearchIsland.tsx, TownZipFieldIsland.tsx, TownPreviewCard region) and email/PDF rendering
stack.output_mode: static (astro.config.mjs output: 'static') — every page prerendered at build time; no SSR
stack.hosting: Netlify (netlify.toml: command 'npm run build', publish 'dist', functions 'netlify/functions')

functions_runtime.netlify: Node functions bundled with esbuild (netlify.toml [functions] node_bundler='esbuild'). process-email-queue.ts is a Netlify Scheduled Function (schedule '0 14 * * *' = 10AM ET daily).
functions_runtime.supabase_edge: Deno (deno.land std@0.168.0 http/server serve), 5 edge functions under supabase/functions/

datastores.static_json: data/processed/counties.json (3 counties) + zipcodes.json (97 zips) committed to repo, read at build time

stack.email: Amazon SES (@aws-sdk/client-ses) sent from inside Supabase edge functions (handle-form-submission, send-scheduled-emails, send-lead-notification). Sender default reports@stevenfrato.com; ConfigurationSet 'steven-frato-emails'; bounce/complaint via ses-webhook-handler.
stack.ai: Anthropic SDK (@anthropic-ai/sdk ^0.52.0) used offline in data/scripts/generate-insights.ts for market commentary; not in request path
stack.security_headers: netlify.toml sets X-Frame-Options DENY, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin. No CSP defined.

routes.purpose: PLACEHOLDER 'Coming Soon' — no IDX/MLS integration; static copy only
ZIP market pages from zipcodes.json; canonical to town page on 1:1 mapping
PRIMARY SEO targets — town-name queries; from src/data/town-mappings.ts
Decision-stage town comparison pages; from src/data/comparisons.ts
Seller-intent conversion pages, lead form above fold

routes_summary: 22 distinct route patterns / page templates in src/pages/; ~357 generated static pages total. /api/market-report is NOT an Astro route — it is a netlify.toml redirect (status 200) to /.netlify/functions/handle-market-report.

forms.submit_target: fetch POST to '/' (Netlify Forms) as application/x-www-form-urlencoded (ContactForm.astro:~251)
forms.mechanism: Netlify Forms (data-netlify='true', method POST). Captured by Netlify regardless of any function. NOT routed to handle-market-report unless a Netlify form-handling redirect/notification is configured (none in netlify.toml — only /api/market-report redirect exists).
forms.downstream_path: Netlify Forms inbox only (no serverless processing wired); success state shown client-side, trackEvent('Lead','Contact Form')

forms.mechanism: Netlify Forms (data-netlify='true'). NOTE: client posts to '/', so the lead lands in Netlify Forms — the Supabase/SES pipeline in handle-market-report only runs for posts that hit /api/market-report. There is NO netlify.toml notification/redirect wiring this Netlify-Forms submission into handle-market-report, so MarketReportForm + ContactForm + QualificationQuiz submissions may capture in Netlify Forms WITHOUT triggering Supabase lead creation or SES emails. VERIFY against Netlify dashboard form-notification config (out-of-repo).
forms.downstream_path: Netlify Forms inbox; client shows success + trackEvent('Lead','Market Report Request')

forms.mechanism: Netlify Forms (data-netlify='true'); multi-step (3 steps) with branch on intent (seller vs buyer step 2). Lead score computed client-side and written to hidden inputs before submit. Same Netlify-Forms-vs-function gap as above.
forms.downstream_path: Netlify Forms inbox; client success + trackEvent('Lead', ...)

forms.submit_target: fetch POST to /api/market-report (ExitIntentPopup.astro:285) — the ONLY form that hits the serverless pipeline
forms.mechanism: CUSTOM endpoint. Form has NO data-netlify attribute (ExitIntentPopup.astro:38-42); posts directly to /api/market-report -> netlify/functions/handle-market-report. Bypasses Netlify Forms entirely (no inbox backup).
forms.honeypot: bot-field input present but NOT enforced server-side (handle-market-report.ts never reads bot-field)
forms.downstream_path: /api/market-report -> handle-market-report.ts -> Supabase edge handle-form-submission (lead insert + scheduled_emails + SES welcome + Steven notification) AND generate-pdf. THIS is the full pipeline; the other 3 forms do not traverse it.

forms_critical_finding: Only ExitIntentPopup posts to the /api/market-report serverless pipeline. ContactForm, MarketReportForm, and QualificationQuiz all fetch POST to '/' (Netlify Forms). Unless Netlify form-submitted notifications are configured to call handle-market-report (not present in repo/netlify.toml), the primary lead forms create NO Supabase lead, schedule NO drip emails, and send NO instant SES notification to Steven. Downstream lanes MUST confirm Netlify dashboard wiring; if absent this is a launch-blocking lead-loss bug.

silent_drop_points.description: Supabase edge function non-OK response or fetch throw is only console.error'd; execution continues. Lead never reaches DB but caller is unaffected.
catch(supabaseError) swallows network failure to Supabase; comment 'Continue with PDF generation even if Supabase fails'. No retry, no queue, no alert.
Fallback trigger-email-sequence failure (only used when Supabase env vars unset) only logged; no retry.
generate-pdf failure only console.error'd; PDF silently never produced.

Handler ALWAYS returns statusCode 200 with generic success message regardless of whether Supabase insert, SES email, or PDF succeeded. Client always shows success; total failure is invisible to user and operator.
Lead insert error returns 500 to caller — but the Netlify caller ignores non-OK (see :156-162) and returns 200 anyway, masking the 500.
Single Supabase insert attempt for the lead — NO retry/backoff on transient failure.
scheduled_emails bulk insert error only console.error'd; the entire 5-email drip is silently not scheduled while lead + welcome email still 'succeed'.
SES welcome-email send failure returns null and is swallowed; lead created but buyer never gets the promised report PDF link. No alert.
CRITICAL: if SES fails to notify Steven, error is only logged. A HOT lead is created in DB but Steven is never pinged — silent lead loss for the human-follow-up path.

Single-fire POST with no persistent queue; on fetch failure only an alert() is shown and sessionStorage flag may already be set, so the user is not re-prompted. No backend retry; no Netlify Forms backup (form lacks data-netlify).
Drip email max_attempts (3) exhaustion sets status 'failed' with no alert to Steven/admin; nurture emails silently die after 3 tries.
Scheduled trigger of send-scheduled-emails only logs non-200 / throw; if the daily cron call fails, the whole drip stalls silently with no alerting.

Honeypot 'bot-field' is collected client-side but NEVER validated server-side in handle-market-report — spam protection on the custom endpoint is effectively absent (Netlify Forms honeypot only protects the '/'-posted forms).

sources.redfin: data/scripts/fetch-data.ts downloads county_market_tracker.tsv000.gz + zip_code_market_tracker.tsv000.gz from redfin-public-data.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com; gunzip; saved to data/raw/ (gitignored).
sources.pipeline: data:fetch -> data:process (process-data.ts filters NJ TARGET_COUNTIES, picks latest record by period_end, computes market_type) -> data:insights (generate-insights.ts, Anthropic) -> data/processed/{counties.json,zipcodes.json} (committed, read at build).

supabase_tables: zipcode_data (synced via netlify/functions/sync-zipcode-data.ts upsert of 97 records, gated by SYNC_SECRET / X-Sync-Secret header)
data_layer.freshness_ttl: NONE enforced. Static JSON is frozen at build time; recency selected only by Redfin period_end (process-data.ts:221,305). No TTL/staleness guard, no rebuild-on-stale; data refresh is manual (npm run data:all + NETLIFY_BUILD_HOOK + sync-zipcode-data). Supabase zipcode_data only updates when sync function is manually invoked.
data_layer.listing_feed: NONE — /listings is a placeholder ('Listings Coming Soon', src/pages/listings.astro). No IDX/MLS integration, no property search, no listing data anywhere in the repo.

components.ExitIntentPopup: src/components/ExitIntentPopup.astro — rendered globally in BaseLayout. Triggers on exit-intent (mouseleave) + sessionStorage flag 'exit_popup_shown' (single fire per session). Mini qualification (interest+timeline) + name/email/zip. Posts to /api/market-report (the only form on the real pipeline).
components.QualificationQuiz: src/components/QualificationQuiz.astro — 3-step branching quiz; client-side lead scoring -> hidden lead-score/lead-temperature. Server mirror of scoring in handle-form-submission (calculateLeadScore). Temperature buckets: hot>=80 / warm>=50 / nurture>=25 / cold. Priority map drives Steven-notification urgency + drip campaign assignment.
components.StickyCTA: src/components/StickyCTA.astro — context-aware href/text set in BaseLayout.astro:64-82 by pathname (town/zip -> #lead-capture 'Get My Free Report'; tools -> 'Get Personalized Analysis'; home-value -> 'Get My Free CMA'; market -> /contact/).
components.UrgencyBanner / MoversAndShakersSection: presentational CRO support; TestimonialCard must NOT be populated with fabricated quotes (per CLAUDE.md).

cro_layer.lead_scoring: Two implementations must stay in sync: client (QualificationQuiz.astro) writes hidden fields; server (supabase handle-form-submission/index.ts:55-144) recomputes and uses client value only if present ('lead-score' param), else server calc. Divergence risk if client tampered or fields renamed.
cro_layer.gating: No cookie/consent gating active. No auth. ExitIntentPopup gated only by sessionStorage single-fire.
cro_layer.ab_or_personalization: No A/B test framework and no runtime personalization detected. Only static pathname-based StickyCTA text/href variation (deterministic, not experimental).
cro_layer.break_risk: ExitIntentPopup is the single form on the live serverless pipeline — if its JS handler or /api/market-report redirect breaks, the ONLY backend-integrated lead path dies while other forms quietly fall back to Netlify Forms inbox. QualificationQuiz client/server score mismatch could misroute hot leads to the cold drip. StickyCTA href regex (BaseLayout:67-82) is brittle to slug format changes.

scripts.name: Matomo Tag Manager

scripts.pii_touched: Pageviews, clicks, tel/mailto clicks, site-search keywords (town/zip typed). No form PII sent to Matomo directly, but URLs/search terms can contain location intent. Loads with NO cookie consent.

scripts.name: Cookie-consent gate
